test_name: Supply Chain Risk Management - SR-11 Secondary Control Gap
architecture:
System: Mission-API-195
Primary NIST family: Supply Chain Risk Management (SR); evidence focus: SR-11.
Environment: GCP. Network access uses Private Service Connect; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a customer-managed Cloud KMS key. Control evidence: an authenticity verification record is complete for production components but one test component record lacks a secondary attestation. The gap is documented as a secondary control deficiency; there is no plaintext transport, no public database exposure, no unencrypted administrator credential in S3, and privileged MFA remains enabled.
